As a user X, I want to do Y, so I can accomplish Z.

the creator of the issue is responsible for determining the number of story points (estimated using relative sizing like 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8), and adding the correct labels to it.
The tasks of the user story are to be created as sub-issue of this one and labeled as tasks.
